$description: Filename-to-language resolution for `@injection.filename`, pinned so the Rust runtime and the browser port cannot drift. Neovim resolves the capture through `vim.filetype.match`; Lumis matches the last path component against the globs in languages.toml, then against the bare extension.
$note: A diff names paths like `b/lib/varsel.ex`, so directories, git's `a/`/`b/` prefixes, and `/dev/null` all reach this function.
